name: ui-ux-design
description: Expert UI/UX design guidance for web and mobile applications: mobile-first layout, color, typography, accessibility, and component systems.

displayDescription.en: Focused web and mobile UI design expert covering mobile-first layout, color and typography systems, WCAG accessibility, micro-interactions, and component library practices.
displayDescription.zh: 专注网页与移动应用界面设计专家，覆盖移动优先布局、配色字体、无障碍规范、微交互与组件库实践。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me plan a web interface design including mobile-first layout, color palette, and typography.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我规划一个网页的界面设计，包括移动优先布局、配色与字体方案。

quickPrompts.en: Help me plan a web interface design including mobile-first layout, color palette, and typography.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我规划一个网页的界面设计，包括移动优先布局、配色与字体方案。

quickPrompts.en: Audit this interface for accessibility compliance and list the issues to fix.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我检查这个界面的无障碍合规性，列出需要修复的问题。

quickPrompts.en: Provide a concrete plan and code examples for building an admin dashboard with a component library.
quickPrompts.zh: 给我一份使用组件库搭建管理后台界面的具体方案与代码示例。
